# Governance process

A governance process is how an account decides. Bodies vote in stages. The protocol calls the process a [plugin](../protocol-doc/framework/plugins.md#what-a-plugin-is); the app installs it for an [account](../accounts/account.md).

## Stages

A process runs one or more stages ([stage](./stage.md)). Each stage has bodies that approve or veto; see [how a stage advances](#bodies) and the [Staged Proposal Processor](./protocol-doc/plugins/spp-plugin.md) at the contract level.

## Bodies

A body is a group that decides in a stage. A Safe can be one ([Safe docs](<https://help.safe.global/en/>)); the platform's [assistance form](https://www.aragon.org/get-assistance-form) arranges the rest.
